WITH patient_averages AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(`aCL IgG`) as A
  FROM Examination
  WHERE `aCL IgG` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(A) as B
  FROM patient_averages
),
filtered_pairs AS (
  SELECT pa.A, oa.B
  FROM patient_averages pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE pa.A > oa.B
)
SELECT 
  AVG(A) as avg_of_A,
  AVG(A - B) as avg_of_A_minus_B
FROM filtered_pairs
